calls.statement:
SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, cp.subcategory,
  sum(f.quantity) AS units_sold,
  (SELECT sum(r.quantity_returned) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store rs ON rs.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product rp ON rp.product_key=r.product_key JOIN dim_product rcp ON rcp.sku=rp.sku AND rcp.is_current WHERE rs.store_id=108 AND rcp.subcategory='Interior Paint' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02') AS units_returned_in_period
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id=108 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=3
  AND cp.subcategory='Interior Paint' AND cp.category<>'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY 1,2,3
